list.snippet: Adoption Date: Officially adopted in April 1973 under Project Tiger to protect declining populations.
Previous Symbol: The Asiatic Lion served as India's national animal until 1972, when the tiger took its place because its habitat spans across the country.
National Heritage Animal: Distinct from the national animal, the Indian Elephant holds the title of national heritage animal.
